sentences.en: I know an English language instructor who comes from Canada.
sentences.zh: 我知道一位来自加拿大的英语教师。

sentences.en: My military instructor was a guy of the special forces.
sentences.zh: 我的军事教练是一位特种部队成员。

sentences.en: The instructor asked the swimmers to float on their stomachs.
sentences.zh: 教练让游泳者仰浮在水面上。
